item: Version floors get something that can contradict them: starlette 1.8.0, ruff==0.17.3, a DuckDB 1.x CI job (R412)
summary: The Starlette floor moves 1.5.0 to 1.8.0 (registry entry starlette-gzip-flush, pyproject and the already-pinned lock together): from 1.8.0 a FileResponse stops at an http.disconnect on a server speaking ASGI < 2.4, so a closed tab ends the database backup stream (measured: 1.7.0 sent all 40 MiB of a 40 MiB file, 1.8.0 1.1 MiB). tests/test_version_floor_legs.py drives the real response (fails on the 1.7.0 wheel), pins the five files that name http.disconnect, the exact ruff and mypy pins and the new job. ruff>=0.16.6,<0.18 becomes ruff==0.17.3 (the ceiling of 412 is now true by construction). ci.yml gains columnar-duckdb1, which installs duckdb<2, checks it got 1.x and runs the same 29 columnar files as the columnar job. The SPDX licence string is not in this change.
